programme.title: The Hunt for Baltic Gold
programme.desc: Amber has been coveted in Poland since the 15th century, when handmade jewellery incorporating this semi-precious stone (even though it is not a 'stone') was sought after by members of the Royal, Imperial, Papal and Ottoman Courts. With 70% of the world's amber being produced in Poland, the industry is still thriving, especially in the coastal areas around the port city of Gdansk. The viewer will learn about the journey of amber, from its origins as fossilized tree resin to its extraction from the ground and its transfromation into creative and beautiful decorations. The show also tells the story of the people who work in the industry and the difficulties they face in harvesting the amber, getting it to market and selling it.

programme.title: Lost Worlds
programme.desc: In the late Stone Age, the pagan people of the British Isles constructed some of the greatest monuments of the ancient world, fabulous constructions of wood, earth, and stone. In this hour, LOST WORLDS travels from the ancient stone villages of Scotland's Orkney Islands to Southern England in search of the soul of the Pagan's mysterious culture. This episode reveals a startling new theory about the role Stonehenge played in the lives of the pagans, while computer animation reconstructs the monument as it appeared to them. Experts trace a forgotten ancient pathway to Stonehenge's lost twin --Woodhenge-- and explore the secrets of Silbury Hill, the world's largest man-made mound. Finally, we'll visit Maiden Castle, a fortress that witnessed the pagan world's end.

programme.title: Cities of the Underworld
programme.desc: In major cities around the world today, skyscrapers loom overhead, taxis honk their horns and street vendors peddle their wares. But below lies city upon city - each with its fascinating and unknown history. This series will explore these layers, which are often hundreds of feet deep, and examine a city's ancient cisterns, dank dungeons, eerie tombs, clandestine hideouts, and even underground shipwrecks that have been lost for hundreds and hundreds of years. What are the underground layers of the most populated cities on earth? And how did (and do) engineers build layer upon layer up to today's city streets? This series will reveal the technological marvels that allowed the construction of one city upon another - literally.

programme.title: Evolve
programme.desc: Throughout the eons of its existence, the natural world has played host to this never-ending competition called life. Since the dawn of time, roughly 99 percent of all species have become extinct. In order to survive, all creatures, including man, must treat life as a battlefield and master the natural weapons and defenses that they have evolved: Tyrannosaurus Rex's 13-inch canines; the Gecko's velcro-like toe pads; the Bald Eagle's telescopic vision capable of spotting a hare a mile away. How did these attributes, each unique to the organism itself, appear? Certainly not arbitrarily. They evolved for a common reason - to give these animals a critical edge in inter-species warfare, and to ensure the survival of the individual's genes into the next generation. To evolve is to survive!

programme.title: Engineering Disasters
programme.desc: On this episode, a massive explosion rocks a small Texas town killing 15 residents. A bridge in Washington collapses sending cars plunging into the river. Two construction cranes in New York City seem to fall from the sky leaving a path of destruction. A ferry full of passenger's encounters trouble and sinks. And a building demolition In Philadelphia goes horribly wrong killing innocent shoppers next door. What do all of these catastrophes have in common? They were caused by engineering failures that led to disasters of epic proportions.

programme.title: Ancient Top 10
programme.desc: Ancient Top 10 is smart, fun countdown that details how ancient technology worked, how surprisingly advanced it was, and how it was kind of awesome. Location shooting, CGI, and graphics are pulled from past History series Ancient Impossible and Ancient Discoveries, and lists are organized by themes. The stories are augmented by new entries fueled by the History archive. Episodes include updated "Top Ten" graphics and new interviews that provide "wow" facts and explain why something made the list. The lists will have organizing principles so it doesn't seem arbitrary. Episodes could include the following: Top 10 Secrets of Egypt, Top 10 Ancient Vikings, Top 10 Greek Inventions, Top 10 Ancient Weapons, Top 10 Ancient Monuments, Top 10 Ancient Ships, Top 10 Torture Devices, Top 10 Roman Inventions, Top 10 Ancient Swords, and Top 10 Ancient Sieges.

programme.title: Serial Killer Earth
programme.desc: In recent years the destructive power of natural disasters has been recorded, from Hurricane Katrina to the earthquake and tsunami that devastated Japan. Serial Killer Earth brings together a top team of experts to examine the most compelling footage from news and home video, as well as eyewitness testimony, in order to explain, understand and inform viewers of what actually happened during these disasters and how they compare and contrast with the most historic natural disasters of the past.

programme.title: The Curse of Civil War Gold
programme.desc: Treasure hunters Rick and Marty Lagina, the stars of History's "The Curse of Oak Island," learn of a new mystery that may even rival Oak Island's. Michigan native Kevin Dykstra is obsessed with a deathbed confession made by a lighthouse keeper in the 1890s about a national treasure dating back to the Civil War. The story goes that Union soldiers tracked down Confederate president Jefferson Davis in 1865 and confiscated his gold. The stolen loot was smuggled north some years later but ended up in Lake Michigan, where Dykstra believes it still remains. His quest to prove it ultimately takes him and his team to the bottom of Lake Michigan.

programme.title: The Hunt for Baltic Gold
programme.desc: Amber has been coveted in Poland since the 15th century, when handmade jewellery incorporating this semi-precious stone (even though it is not a 'stone') was sought after by members of the Royal, Imperial, Papal and Ottoman Courts. With 70% of the world's amber being produced in Poland, the industry is still thriving, especially in the coastal areas around the port city of Gdansk. The viewer will learn about the journey of amber, from its origins as fossilized tree resin to its extraction from the ground and its transfromation into creative and beautiful decorations. The show also tells the story of the people who work in the industry and the difficulties they face in harvesting the amber, getting it to market and selling it.

programme.title: Lost Worlds
programme.desc: In the late Stone Age, the pagan people of the British Isles constructed some of the greatest monuments of the ancient world, fabulous constructions of wood, earth, and stone. In this hour, LOST WORLDS travels from the ancient stone villages of Scotland's Orkney Islands to Southern England in search of the soul of the Pagan's mysterious culture. This episode reveals a startling new theory about the role Stonehenge played in the lives of the pagans, while computer animation reconstructs the monument as it appeared to them. Experts trace a forgotten ancient pathway to Stonehenge's lost twin --Woodhenge-- and explore the secrets of Silbury Hill, the world's largest man-made mound. Finally, we'll visit Maiden Castle, a fortress that witnessed the pagan world's end.

programme.title: Cities of the Underworld
programme.desc: In major cities around the world today, skyscrapers loom overhead, taxis honk their horns and street vendors peddle their wares. But below lies city upon city - each with its fascinating and unknown history. This series will explore these layers, which are often hundreds of feet deep, and examine a city's ancient cisterns, dank dungeons, eerie tombs, clandestine hideouts, and even underground shipwrecks that have been lost for hundreds and hundreds of years. What are the underground layers of the most populated cities on earth? And how did (and do) engineers build layer upon layer up to today's city streets? This series will reveal the technological marvels that allowed the construction of one city upon another - literally.

programme.title: Evolve
programme.desc: Throughout the eons of its existence, the natural world has played host to this never-ending competition called life. Since the dawn of time, roughly 99 percent of all species have become extinct. In order to survive, all creatures, including man, must treat life as a battlefield and master the natural weapons and defenses that they have evolved: Tyrannosaurus Rex's 13-inch canines; the Gecko's velcro-like toe pads; the Bald Eagle's telescopic vision capable of spotting a hare a mile away. How did these attributes, each unique to the organism itself, appear? Certainly not arbitrarily. They evolved for a common reason - to give these animals a critical edge in inter-species warfare, and to ensure the survival of the individual's genes into the next generation. To evolve is to survive!

programme.title: Детали
programme.desc: Как добывать воду даже в самых засушливых местах: поможет изобретение. Ученые нашли применение одноразовому пластику. Даже слабовидящие собаки отлично ориентируются в пространстве: почему? Неиссякаемые источники энергии: где они и как работают?

programme.title: Детали
programme.desc: Eженедельный телевизионный проект Русской службы "Голоса Америки", в котором ведущий Андрей Деркач рассказывает о научных открытиях и высокотехнологичных разработках в таких сферах, как медицина, космос, информационные технологии. Корреспонденты программы на себе испытывают новинки рынка hi-tech, общаются с создателями всего того, что делает нашу жизнь интереснее, безопаснее и удобнее.

programme.title: Детали
programme.desc: Ученые создали сенсоры, имитирующие работу сразу нескольких органов чувств человека. Парализованный пациент, которому вживили в мозг специальный имплант, получил возможность говорить. В Орегоне делают водородное топливо из воды фермерских хозяйств.

programme.title: Бывшие
programme.desc: Ольга и Дмитрий Степановы уже год в разводе, но по-прежнему вместе руководят филиалом крупной торговой сети под названием \"Дружная семья\". Страсти после развода утихли. Ольга замужем за известным скрипачом и беспомощным романтиком Яшей. Её счастливую жизнь осложняет лишь свекровь Дора Гордеевна, привыкшая опекать сына. А бывший муж Дмитрий Степанов женат на доброй и хозяйственной девушке Миле. Но как снег на голову, на бывших супругов обрушивается известие — в их город с проверкой приезжает владелец \"Дружной семьи\" Фёдоров. Он не должен узнать о разводе Степановых — по контракту они обязаны придерживаться семейных ценностей.

programme.desc: Ольга и Дмитрий Степановы уже год в разводе, но по-прежнему вместе руководят филиалом крупной торговой сети под названием \"Дружная семья\". Страсти после развода утихли. programme.title: Пять минут тишины. Возвращение
programme.desc: Александр Грек, вернувшись после стажировки в Москву и узнав, что его невеста Лина, с которой он собирался окончательно расстаться, беременна, принимает решение жениться на матери своего ребенка. Однако остаться в столице у него не получается: ему уготована служба в отдалённом районе, и он просит направить его назад, в Карелию. Лина решает ехать с ним и там играть свадьбу. Вернувшись в Карелию, Греку предстоит пережить объяснение с Таней, которую он любит, и с Гиреевым, который зол на молодого человека, заставившего страдать его дочь.

programme.title: Пять минут тишины. Возвращение
programme.desc: Александр Грек, вернувшись после стажировки в Москву и узнав, что его невеста Лина, с которой он собирался окончательно расстаться, беременна, принимает решение жениться на матери своего ребенка. programme.title: Желание сердца
programme.desc: На этот раз исполнится заветное желание Сандера: когда-то он был успешным предпринимателем, но банкротство привело его к торговле наркотиками и тюремному заключению. После освобождения Сандер решил полностью изменить свою жизнь и начал помогать бездомным: уже 5 лет он раздает им еду на центральном рынке и старается помочь выбраться с улицы в нормальную жизнь.

programme.title: Ремонт на сдачу
programme.desc: Кейли и Мерлин направляются в Пярну на помощь Сильверу, который собирается сделать сюрприз своему отцу - преобразить его квартиру под сдачу. Всего за 2 недели им предстоит превратить тесное жилье с устаревшим интерьером в романтичное гнездышко.

programme.title: Провинциальный детектив
programme.desc: В окрестностях города Мухина идут археологические раскопки, во время которых начинают случаться мистические смерти. По преданиям на месте раскопок располагается один из важнейших языческих капищ древних славян, и археологи платят за свое святотатство. Татьяна и Ольга, конечно, не верят в пророчества и пытаются выяснить, кто стоит за этими паранормальными смертями. И снова на помощь нашим героиням приходит мастер детективного жанра Эркюль Пуаро, который утверждает, что жажда больших денег всегда являлась мотивом многих преступлений.

programme.title: Провинциальный детектив
programme.desc: В окрестностях города Мухина идут археологические раскопки, во время которых начинают случаться мистические смерти. По преданиям на месте раскопок располагается один из важнейших языческих капищ древних славян, и археологи платят за свое святотатство. programme.title: Провинциальный детектив
programme.desc: Заведующая городской библиотекой Татьяна Дашкова и медсестра Ольга Брянцева живут в небольшом очаровательном городке с древней историей и дружат с детства. Образованность, начитанность и неиссякаемый интерес к жизни Татьяны, в сочетании с практичностью, находчивостью и живостью ума Ольги дают удивительные результаты. Их тандем способен разобраться в самых запутанных ситуациях и выяснить истинные мотивы любого преступления, которых случается немало в этом, кажущемся спокойным, городке. Главное — внимание к мелочам и деталям, а также хорошее знание детективной литературы. Ведь героиням во всех делах помогают Шерлок Холмс, Отец Браун и другие известные детективы из произведений классической литературы.

programme.title: Провинциальный детектив
programme.desc: Заведующая городской библиотекой Татьяна Дашкова и медсестра Ольга Брянцева живут в небольшом очаровательном городке с древней историей и дружат с детства. programme.title: Следствие вели...
programme.desc: Эти уголовные дела гремели на весь Советский Союз. По ним были написаны романы и сняты художественные фильмы. Их фигуранты — миллионеры эпохи социализма, хитроумные воры, профессиональные грабители и валютчики. Они бросили вызов советскому обществу. Вызов приняли лучшие сыщики страны. В их распоряжении не было компьютеров, сотовой связи и бойцов ОМОНа. Но это не мешало вершиться правосудию. Банда "Черная кошка", дело банды советских гангстеров конца 60-х годов, прозванных "Фантомасами", увлекательная история налетчика Леонида Пантелеева, "свободного художника-грабителя" — эти случаи вошли в историю отечественной криминалистики. Но главная цель сериала — не просто рассказать о преступлениях и злоумышленниках советского времени, а показать ушедшую эпоху так, чтобы молодые зрители смогли прочувствовать дух ушедшего времени, а зрители постарше — ностальгию по прошлому.

programme.title: Норвег
programme.desc: Как снег на голову москвича Кириллова сваливается руководство клининговым агентством \"Настенька\", состоящим целиком из мигранток-азиаток. Ситуация осложняется тем, что Кириллов планирует уехать в Норвегию и ждет в гости невесту — типичную европейку с весьма жесткими понятиями о свободе и толерантности. Мысль о том, что она узнает об эксплуатации \"женщин Востока\" приводит его в ужас и заставляет всячески изворачиваться, скрывая \"гарем\"...

programme.title: Музыкальная интуиция
programme.desc: Вокально-экспериментальное шоу \"Музыкальная интуиция\" объединит и перемешает профессиональных вокалистов с теми, кто совершенно не умеет петь. В каждом выпуске две команды звездных судей будут соревноваться между собой. Им предстоит угадывать, кто из участников, выходящих на сцену, обладает великолепным вокалом, а кто выступает только в караоке. Члены жюри не смогут слышать, как поют участники, им придется делать выбор, опираясь лишь на сценические навыки выступающих и свою интуицию.

programme.title: Специальная военная чеченская
programme.desc: В январе 2025-го исполняется тридцать лет со дня печально известного новогоднего штурма Грозного. В тактическом плане бои в столице мятежной Чечни для Кремля обернулись крупнейшим в новейшей военной истории провалом. В человеческом — десятками тысяч погибших, прежде всего, среди мирных жителей, которых, казалось бы, и \"освобождали\". Именно в те дни стало ясно: блицкриг, затеянный Москвой, превратился в затяжную войну. Первую чеченскую. Первую из больших войн, которые вела современная Россия. Внешние сходства между той \"спецоперацией\" и нынешней очевидны любому. Но что это: совпадения или закономерности? Можно ли утверждать, будто сегодняшние Россия и война в Украине — корнями из войны той, чеченской? И почему попытка силой изменить крохотную республику изменила в итоге самих россиян? Ключевые действующие лица эпохи рассказывают о принятии решений, которые и привели к войне.

programme.title: CNN Newsroom
programme.desc: CNN Newroom provides the most up to date news as it breaks and is the longest running show on the channel, airing twice a day Monday to Friday and throughout the day over the weekends. CNN has developed a lot since its founding in 1980 by American media proprietor Ted Turner as a 24 hour cable news channel. As an organisation, CNN have won multiple awards, including a network-record six news & documentary Emmy Awards in 2018.

programme.title: Smerconish
programme.desc: Michael Smerconish tackles the American political and news stories of the week, offering only one kind of talking point: his own.

programme.title: World Sport
programme.desc: One of the CNN's longest running programmes that allows viewers to find out all the global sports news, see all the important events and most interesting parts, and enjoy the interviews with sports pundits and various sports stars.

programme.title: African Voices
programme.desc: Shining a spotlight on Africa's most influential and inspiring talents through in-depth, authentic conversations. Hosted by Larry Madowo.

programme.title: Inside Africa
programme.desc: Each week, Inside Africa documentary series on CNN highlights the unique diversity of mysterious Africa, its numerous cultures and religions, peoples, art, music, cuisine, travel and literature, its one-of-a-kind flora and fauna. Watch the interviews with people from various spheres of life and find out more surprising facts about this continent: how it fights for conservation of rare animals, who the new figures in fashion and design are, what the new educational programs for children look like. Everything what Africa is filled with and lives for is in this series.

programme.title: African Voices
programme.desc: Shining a spotlight on Africa's most influential and inspiring talents through in-depth, authentic conversations. Hosted by Larry Madowo.

programme.title: Connecting Africa
programme.desc: The African continent is going through a big transformation and this CNN magazine presents the entrepreneurs, companies and projects that are working hard to modernise it and make its economic integration possible. Hosted by Eleni Giokos, the episodes bring stories about the fast growing industry, network communication, cross-border trade and increasing trading routes, air connectivity, logistics infrastructure, small businesses and more.

programme.title: Marketplace Middle East
programme.desc: Business show revolves around cutting edge economic trends and latest business developments in the Middle East. The focus is on the key cities of the region, its most important sectors and industries. The guests of the show are significant representatives of the business community in the region.

programme.title: Marketplace Africa
programme.desc: Unique access to the latest African market information, with a look at events and developments that impact its business world. Follow the business stories that influence the African continent. Eleni Giokos is a CNN correspondent based in the network's Johannesburg bureau and the show's host. Every week she interviews figures of business and industry to reveal the economic trends in various regions of Africa and to present the continent's key sectors and corporations.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons are a totally normal family. Dad is your regular 6"4 pink rabbit who stays at home while Mom works in a rainbow factory. Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons run over Santa Claus and must save Christmas. / Gumball and Darwin receive an heirloom from Richard but lose it. / Bobert loses a bet to Gumball so has to obey him for 24 hours. / Gumball asks Idaho to teach his family to live a simpler life. / Gumball teaches Darwin a lesson after Darwin leaves him. / Granny JoJo's overprotective behavior puts the Wattersons in danger. / Gumball thinks Teri is way too scared of germs. / Gumball and Darwin rent a film called A Pony's Tail to watch with Anais but keep getting distracted on their way home. / Gumball destroys Alan and Carmen's relationship and has to reunite them.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, Beast Boy and Raven continue the fun in season seven of TEEN TITANS GO! with all-new comedic adventures, giving viewers a look at what life is really like as a teen super hero ... once the cape comes off. Inspired by and featuring the principal voice cast of the original Teen Titans series, this character-driven comedy - based upon DC characters - focuses on the funny that happens in between saving the world and living together as teenagers without adult supervision. With epic staring contests to decide who does the laundry, a series of quests and battles to construct the perfect sandwich or fighting crime in Jump City, one thing is for sure - these Titans are always ready for an adventure, inside the house and out.

programme.title: Craig of the Creek
programme.desc: Craig and his two best friends, Kelsey and JP, are always going on adventures in the untamed suburban wilderness known as the Creek - a kid utopia where tribes of children rule over tree forts and bike ramps, making up an entire kid society. Each episode finds the kids either venturing into unexplored areas of the Creek, encountering new Creek Kids, or just getting into trouble at their hang out - the Stump.

programme.title: Lana Longbeard
programme.desc: Lana is a super-feisty, forward-thinking and passionate 11-year-old girl, who is also the heir to her father's adventuring ship, the Mighty Windbreaker. Along with her captain dad and his diverse crew (an orc, a dwarf, a barbarian and a cyclops), she sails across the Ten Realms, dreaming of becoming one of the greatest adventurers of all time. But first, she must overcome some challenging obstacles: impulsivity, stubbornness, extreme curiosity, disdain for rules … and a love of pancakes. All the best things about her!

programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: Mordecai the blue jay and Rigby the raccoon hate having to do work as groundskeepers at the local park, trying to slack off whenever they can. When they have simple problems to solve, they often lead to a surreal, extreme, and often supernatural misadventures. Usually this makes their boss, Benson (a gumball machine) extremely angry and on the verge to fire them and annoys their coworker, Skips (a yeti, voiced by Mark Hamill). The pair are always saved by the other manager/owner Pops (a man with a lollipop-shaped head) as he enjoys their constant antics. Co-workers Muscle-Man (an overweight, green man) and Hi-Five Ghost sometimes get involved in the shenanigans, but usually find a way out and leave Mordecai and Rigby in the firing line.

programme.title: Clarence
programme.desc: Follow the daily adventures of a 10-year-old boy named Clarence, and his two best friends Sumo and Jeff. Clarence lives with his mother Mary and her boyfriend Chad in the fictional town of Aberdale, and he is optimistic, curious, honest and quirky boy, who sees the best in everyone and gets himself in a variety of funny situations and everyday problems, which he solves with lots of imagination and with the help from his friends.

programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: Mordecai the blue jay and Rigby the raccoon hate having to do work as groundskeepers at the local park, trying to slack off whenever they can. When they have simple problems to solve, they often lead to a surreal, extreme, and often supernatural misadventures. Usually this makes their boss, Benson (a gumball machine) extremely angry and on the verge to fire them and annoys their coworker, Skips (a yeti, voiced by Mark Hamill). The pair are always saved by the other manager/owner Pops (a man with a lollipop-shaped head) as he enjoys their constant antics. Co-workers Muscle-Man (an overweight, green man) and Hi-Five Ghost sometimes get involved in the shenanigans, but usually find a way out and leave Mordecai and Rigby in the firing line.

programme.title: Adventure Time
programme.desc: Adventure Time is an American fantasy animated television series that shows a 12-year-old boy Finn and his best friend, a wise 28-year-old (in dog years) dog Jake with magical powers living in Lands of Ooo in post-apocalyptic world. They lean on each other during good and bad times, trust each another with secrets and look to each other for advice. Finn likes to travel and save princesses from evil monsters in Lands of Ooo. Jake is more than his friend, he is his mentor, and his extraordinary skills help the boy to fight evil. Finn and Jake hang out with Princess Bubblegum, the sovereign of the Candy Kingdom, the fearsome Ice King, an ice wizard, Marceline the Vampire Queen, a 1000-year-old vampire and rock musician and many more.

Food Guide
programme.desc: Travelxp starts new food and travel documentary series Food Guide hosted by Joe Remblance. Joe is well known for his passion for food and creativity. He travels and looks for food in cutting-edge restaurants and eclectic eateries and bars. From traditional national dishes that is on everyone's lips to something unlooked for and unexpected, Joe guides you through all of it and describes the food in his own mouthwatering way.

programme.title: Xplore Philippines
programme.desc: Join Indian movie star Elisha Kriis as she travels the archipelagic Philippines, uncovering the world of paradise this picturesque country has to offer. Compromising 7,641 islands, the Philippines boasts some of our planet's most idyllic beaches and blissful blue waters that draw in millions of tourists every year. With a population of over 104 million people, presenter Elisha Kriis reveals the history behind this former Spanish colony and what makes it uniquely different to its Southeast Asian neighbours. programme.title: Joel Ostrati suur õhtusöök
programme.desc: Kirglik toidunautija Epp Kärsin on seni pigem eelistanud, et kulinaarseid kõrgpunkte pakuks talle teised, sest naudingukoolitajale endale meeldib kodus kokkamise asemel einestada hoopis restoranides. Kuidas saab Epp hakkama aga siis, kui ta peab ise looma oivalisi restoranihõrgutisi? Suur õhtusöök toimub sel korral intiimses õhustikus: Epp ja Joel serveerivad küllusliku õhtusöögi Tallinna südames asuva luksushotelli L'Embitu numbritubadesse.

programme.title: STOP!
programme.desc: Saatejuht Allan Muuk hoiab kätt pulsil liiklusteemadel, mille ring on lai ning pidevas muutumises. Allan toob kokkuvõtlikult välja nädala probleempunktid, kajastades neid nii liiklusspetsialistide kui lihtsa inimese vaatenurgast. Saates jagatud infot täiendavad usaldusväärsed faktid, selgitavad intervjuud ning operatiivsed reportaažid.

programme.title: Kellapid
programme.desc: Mustamäel toimuvad illegaalsed kihlveod, kus panustatakse uue spordiala, trollistrügimise võitjatele. Oma trügimisoskused otsustab proovile panna ka Endli ema. Lendab verd ja mängus on suured summad. Stsenarist Mart Juur, režissöör Indrek Simm. Osades Ago Anderson, Raivo E. Tamm, Merle Palmiste, Peeter Oja, Jan Uuspõld, Kaisa Selde.

programme.title: Doktor Silva
programme.desc: Väikese maakoha perearstikeskusse tuleb tööle uus ja peen perearst Tallinnast – doktor Silva, kes on harjunud ooperis käima, kalamarja sööma ja kübaraid kandma. Nüüd peab pealinna daam kohanema aga hoopis uue ja otsekohesema elustiiliga. Lisaks punuvad tema vastu intriige perearstikeskusest vallandatud endine perearst Heimar ja pereõde Ester. Kange iseloomuga Doktor Silva ei kohku aga tagasi ja hakkab tegelema kohaliku rahva eriskummaliste haigusjuhtumitega, üritab külarahva umbusuga võidelda ja kõigele lisaks varjab ta oma hingesopis hämarat saladust, mis oli tema pealinnast pagemise põhjuseks.

programme.title: Mõrvaennetajad
programme.desc: Avahooajal USAs laineid löönud põnevussari salapärasest miljardärist, kes värbab endale appi endise CIA agendi, et ühiselt ennetada New Yorki ähvardavaid ränki kuritegusid. Pururikas geenius Finch ("Teadmata kadunud" staar Michael Emerson) on välja töötanud arvutiprogrammi, mis suudab tuvastada potentsiaalse mõrvari või tema ohvri veel enne selle kuriteo reaalset toimumist. Endine eriagent Reese (Jim Caviezel), kes pärast isiklikku tragöödiat elab New Yorkis kodutuna, on nõus Fichiga kampa lööma ja aitab Finchil huvipakkuva isiku üles leida. Reese'i ülesandeks jääb ka tulevase tapja kahjutuks tegemine. Loomulikult peab tandem tegutsema ülima saladuskatte all, sest nende info ja tegevuse paljastamise tagajärjed oleksid katastroofilised.

programme.title: Stumptown
programme.desc: Lootuses saada paberitega eradetektiiviks, soovib Dex, et veteran-eradetektiiv Artie Banks teda juhendaks. Samal ajal kasvab hakkab Hoffman Gray'd kahtlustama, kui tõendid näitavad, et tal on juhtumisi seos ohvriga.

programme.title: Stumptown
programme.desc: Dex tahab saada eradetektiivi litsentsi ning soovib küsida nõu vana eradetektiivi Artie Banksi käest. Hoffman muutub Grey osas kahtlustavaks, kui asitõendid näitavad, et ta on ühe surnud endise vangiga seotud.

programme.title: Surmarelv
programme.desc: Legendaarsetel "Surmarelva" filmidel põhinev veriväske action-komöödiasari toob taas kokku kinoajaloo vingeima detektiivide paari! Oma naist leinav endine eriüksuslane Martin Riggs (Clayne Crawford) ja pärast infarkti tööle naasev Roger Murtaugh (Damon Wayans) moodustavad üdini vastandliku, aga ometi ideaalselt toimiva tandemi. Nende koostöö algus on okkaline, sest ohjeldamatu Riggsi pea-ees-tulle-sööstmise suhtumine põrkub vaoshoitud Murtaugh arusaamadega. Esimese ühise juhtumi lõppedes mõistavad aga mõlemad, et on lisaks uuele paarimehele leidnud endale ka parima sõbra.

programme.title: Georgia reegel
programme.desc: Mässava tütrega võitlemast väsinud ema saadab tolle range vanaema juurde. Pirtsakas neiu proovib ka kolkas iseloomi näidata. Mis on tema väljakutsuva käitumise taga?

programme.title: Seal, kus süda
programme.desc: 17-aastane rase Novalee Nation põgeneb oma armsamaga kodust. Unistav noormees jätab ta Oklahoma osariigis Sequoyah kaubanduskeskuses maha ja tüdruk peab enda eluga ise hakkama saama.

programme.title: Kummituslinn
programme.desc: Kiuslik Bertram sureb ootamatult, kuid ärkab seitsme minuti pärast taas imetabaselt ellu. Ta avastab, et on saanud võime näha surnute vaime.

programme.title: Kuu parim töötaja
programme.desc: Kastitassija Zack Bradley ja kassapidaja Vince Downey on kaks supermarketi rivaalitsevat töötajat. Vince on saanud peakassiiriks ning valiti 17 korda järjest kuu parimaks töötajaks. Zack on igavene lohe, aga oma kollegide hulgas hinnatud mees. Kui tööle saabub uus kassapidaja, silmipimestavalt kaunis ja seksikas Amy, muutub poes kõik. Zack ja Vince hakkavad võyitlema Amy tähelepanu nimel. Vince võlub naist oma kassapidamisoskuste ja auhindadega, Zack püüab võita Amy poolehoidu oma sarmi ja naljadega.

programme.title: Rango
programme.desc: USA 2011 seikluslik animakomöödia Lavastaja: Gore Verbinski Osades (hääled): Märt Avandi (Rango), Elina Pähklimägi, Mati Palm, Egon Nuter, Indrek Ojari, Tõnu Aav, Aleksander Eelmaa, Andrus Vaarik, Tõnu Oja, Raivo E. Tamm, Väino Aren, Andres Ots, Mart Toome, Tarmo Männard, Raimo Pass, Taavi Teplenkov, Guido Kangur, Marilyn Jurman, Jaan Rekkor jt. Kameeleon nimega Rango, kes unistab elust vesternikangelasena, satub pärast autoavariid Pori-nimelisse väikelinna, mida kimbutavad bandiidid. Nüüd peab ta end kokku võttes saama reaalses elus just selliseks tegelaseks, kes ta on alati oma unistustes olnud. "Rango" on üks omanäolise huumorimeelega animakomöödia, mille lavastajaks Gore Verbinski ("Kariibi mere piraadid") ning mille tegelased räägivad sulaselges eesti keeles. Dublaazhi lavastajaks on Peeter Urbla. (Originaalversioonis astuvad üles Johnny Depp, Isla Fisher, Abigail Breslin, Bill Nighy, Stephen Root, Ray Winstone, Harry Dean Stanton, Alfred Molina jt.)

programme.title: Õelad tüdrukud
programme.desc: USA 2004 Komöödia Lavastaja: Mark S. Waters Osades: Lindsay Lohan, Rachel McAdams, Lacey Chabert, Amanda Seyfried Cady Heron (Lindsay Lohan) on 15-aastane tüdruk, kes on terve elu koos zooloogidest vanematega Aafrika põõsaste all veetnud. Nüüd peab ta astuma aga tavalisse kooli ning kogeb omal nahal, et dzhungliseadused seal ei kehti. Tema teadmised ja arvamused olelusvõitlusest saavad hoopis uue tähenduse. Pikkus: 1 tund 37 minutit

programme.title: Kübaraga kass
programme.desc: Kahe igavleva lapse elu pööratakse pea peale, kui neile tuleb külla rääkiv kass.

programme.title: Farmi peoloomad
programme.desc: Kui farmer on ära, siis kõik loomad mängivad, laulavad ja tantsivad. Lõpuks peab aga keegi sekkuma ja juhtimise üle võtma ning vastutus jääb muretu lehma Otise kanda.

programme.title: Kuidas olla latiinost armastaja
programme.desc: Maximo lapsepõlveunistus leida rikas naine, et ei peaks kunagi tööd tegema, läheb täide, kuid 25 aasta pärast vahetatakse ta välja noorema mehe vastu. Nüüd tuleb tal uuesti iseseisvalt elama õppida.

programme.title: Oo vend, kus oled sa?
programme.desc: Suurbritannia/Prantsuse/USA 2000 komöödia Lavastaja: Joel Coen Osades: George Clooney, John Turturro, Tim Blake Nelson, Hully Hunter Parima stsenaariumi ja operaatoritöö Oscarile kandideerinud lustakas linateos viib meid depressiooniaja Ameerikasse, kus kolm vangi on otsustanud oma karistusaega omavoliliselt lühendada. Nende ninameheks on suure suuga Everett Ulysses McGill (George Clooney), kes on oma saatusekaaslased, Pete'i ja Delmari (John Turturro ja Tim Blake Nelson), põgenema meelitanud, lubades neile osalust varandusest, mille asukohta ta teadvat. Algab hullumeelne teekond, mille kestel ristuvad nende teed ohtliku pangaröövli George "Babyface" Nelsoniga, tantsivate Ku-Klux-Klani liikmetega ja oma hinge kuradile müünud kitarristiga. Samas püsib nende kandadel halastamatu seadusesilm...

programme.title: Põgenev pruut
programme.desc: Romantiline draama väikelinna iludusest Maggi Carpenterist (Julia Roberts), kes armastab hirmsal kombel pulmakleidis altari ette kõndida ent siis põgeneda. Tavaliselt lõpeb jalutuskäik altarini laulatusega, kuid Maggie'ga juba nii ei juhtu - tema on juba kolm korda altari ette jõudnud ja täpselt samapalju kordi sealt tuhatnelja põgenenud ja kõik peiud pika ninaga jätnud. Argpüks? Meestesolgutaja? Vastuse jahil saabub väikelinna Ike Graham (Richard Gere) - New Yorgi reporter, kes soovib veidrast pulmapõgenikust loo kirjutada.

programme.title: Valusad võmmid
programme.desc: Inglismaa 2007 märulikomöödia Lavastaja: Edgar Wright Osades: Simon Pegg, Nick Frost, Jim Broadbent, Paddy Considine, Timothy Dalton Nicholas Angel (Simon Pegg) on Londoni edukaim politseinik, kelle tulemused on kolleegide omadest ligi 400% paremad. Ta on lausa nii suurepärane, et kõik teised tunduvad tema kõrval kahvatud. Seetõttu otsustatakse mees saata väikelinna Sandfordi, kus ta täht ei lööks niivõrd särama. Algul näiline tagasilöök saab aga väärt kulminatsiooni, kui Sandfordis hakkab juhtuma rida kummalisi ja veriseid juhtumeid. Uinuval väikelinnal on aeg saada tubli annus suurlinna õiglust. Pikkus: 2 tundi 1 minutit
